message: バランスインザダーク

name: Paqy
message: 「Yo, Lord Synn, what'd you come to the girls' dorm for? No boys allowed here, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「I know I can't go inside, sure, but I can still visit the caretaker's office.」

name: Synn
message: 「I just wanted to have a quick word with the dorm mother.」

name: Paqy
message: 「When it comes to dorm mothers, they're usually battle-hardened, gutsy mama types... Impressive that your strike zone reaches even that far, Lord Demon King.」

name: Synn
message: 「Paqy? I don't really get what you're talking about.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Acting all innocent like that to tickle the maternal instincts of older women, huh? Truly worthy of the Demon King.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, if it isn't Lord Synn! Fancy meeting you in such an unusual place.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh? Shio-chan, you just came out of the dorm, didn't you?」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed. I have just returned from visiting the room of a classmate who is out sick.」

name: Shio
message: 「I paid her a visit with today's notes and handouts, and gave her a stern pep talk as proof of our friendship.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, it is the change of seasons, after all. No matter how careful you are, some people still end up catching a bug.」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, in the case of my classmate, it was a matter prior to mere mindfulness! She brought this entirely upon herself!」

name: Shio
message: 「She gathered old newspapers from the faculty room and tried to trade them in for toilet paper. Truly, how scandalous!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sounds like a good thing to me.」

name: Shio
message: 「Most certainly not! She was misting the old newspapers with a spray bottle, quite literally watering down the weight to pad the scales.」

name: Shio
message: 「For the heavier the bundle, the greater the quantity of goods they will exchange for it.」

name: Shio
message: 「However, heaven's net casts wide, coarse though its meshes be, nothing slips through!」

name: Shio
message: 「In the midst of this wicked deed, she accidentally soaked herself like a drowned rat, and as a result, her cold took a turn for the worse.」

name: Synn
message: 「She must have been so frustrated, poor girl... *sniff*」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Why are you sympathizing with her?」

name: Shio
message: 「Just as the spirit says. There is no room for extenuating circumstances.」

name: Synn
message: 「You think so? You still went out of your way to visit her, Shio-chan, so you clearly care about your friend.」

name: Shio
message: 「Nugugu...」

name: Shio
message: 「H-However, without even needing my reprimand, my classmate was thoroughly scolded by the Dormitory Matron and expressed deep remorse」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, she sounds like a great dorm matron. I definitely want to meet her」

name: Shio
message: 「You have business with the Dormitory Matron? Why is that?」

name: Synn
message: 「I wanted to hear what she has to say」

name: Synn
message: 「There's a Charity Bazaar on October 27th, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「As the Student Council, we want to propose some new ideas, so I want to hear opinions from all kinds of people first」

name: Synn
message: 「All the students, the teachers, volunteers who participated in last year's bazaar, and also--」

name: Shio
message: 「And someone who showers the students with affection while holding a different perspective from the teachers. In other words, the Dormitory Matron?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「Ryuusei Academy has a lot of refined young ladies, and the dorms are pretty stylish too」

name: Synn
message: 「Even so, the dorm students aren't snobby at all, and they look like they're really enjoying their academy life」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure Azel will warm up to everyone soon and start having a blast in the dorms too」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed, my classmate's actions could be considered mere mischief born of such a free-spirited atmosphere」

name: Shio
message: 「Lord Synn, if it is not an intrusion, might I be permitted to accompany you to this meeting with the Dormitory Matron?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Y-Yeah, I don't mind at all」

name: Synn
message: 「Actually, heading in there alone as a guy makes me a little nervous, so I'd practically beg you to come with me」

name: Shio
message: 「You have my gratitude for so graciously accepting my sudden request」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, so you were interested in Student Council activities, Shio-chan. Are you going to run for office next year like Misa?」

name: Shio
message: 「Nay, such a burden would be far too heavy for the likes of me」

name: Shio
message: 「It is merely... that I wished to witness with my own eyes the work of the person my elder sister has challenged to a contest」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I'm really not doing anything that impressive, you know?」

name: Shio
message: 「All great talents say as much」

name: Synn
message: 「Seriously, it's really not that big of a deal. You'll see once you come with me」

name: Shio
message: 「Yes, I shall gladly accompany you!」
With Shio-chan in tow, I head toward the student dorm manager's office.
